name: Reeling Lancer (Combat)
body:
Your lance blows can be devastating, leaving your foes quieted.

Prerequisite(s): Mounted Combat, Ride-by Attack, Improved Critical (any polearm), base attack bonus +9

Benefit(s): When damaging with a mounted charge using a polearm you have chosen for Improved Critical and moving at least your mount’s full base movement speed, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for one round.
